verdict.rationale: Greptile provides 'Fix with your Agent' and 'Fix All' buttons that send suggested code, file paths, and line numbers to an external coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Devin) for one-click remediation, which is close to the story but requires routing through an agent rather than a native GitHub-style committable suggestion diff applied instantly in the PR UI. Missing for 10: evidence of a native inline 'suggested change' diff block that can be committed directly via GitHub/GitLab's own commit-suggestion UI without invoking an external agent, and independent confirmation that the one-click agent fix actually results in a committed diff.
